fato_historico: 461: Western Roman Emperor Majorian is arrested near Tortona (northern Italy) and deposed by the Suebian general Ricimer.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests that even when authority shifts like ancient empires, your inner strength remains sovereign. Perhaps it is a good time to reconsider your own boundaries and release what no longer serves your spirit. You may find that embracing change allows you to flourish with newfound grace, much like a field of four-leaf clovers waiting to be discovered.
frase_do_dia: Your gentle heart is the true architect of your beautiful destiny.
significado_numero: Represents the steady balance of change and lasting inner stability.
conselho: Trust your intuition and allow yourself the space to gracefully shift your perspective.
